avoid_supplements.name: Cholinergic supplements (acetylcholine precursors, alpha-GPC)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Direct antagonism of trihexyphenidyl's anticholinergic effects, reducing therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; maintain minimum 2-4 hour separation if necessary

avoid_supplements.name: Anticholinergic herbal products (datura, jimsonweed, belladonna)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive anticholinergic effects leading to severe toxicity, urinary retention, hyperthermia
avoid_supplements.action: Absolutely contraindicated; educate patient on identification and avoidance

caution_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
caution_supplements.mechanism: May induce hepatic metabolism of trihexyphenidyl, potentially reducing drug levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for decreased efficacy; may require dose adjustment

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mild anticholinergic properties; additive CNS effects possible
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for increased dry mouth or constipation

avoid_foods.name: High-fiber foods in excess
avoid_foods.mechanism: Anticholinergic effects reduce GI motility; excessive fiber may precipitate severe constipation or impaction
avoid_foods.action: Maintain moderate, balanced fiber intake; ensure adequate hydration

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing foods/beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: CNS stimulation may counteract anticholinergic sedation; combined effect on heart rate and tremor possible
caution_foods.action: Monitor tolerance; limit excessive intake and monitor for increased tremor or palpitations

monitoring_notes: Monitor for anticholinergic toxicity signs: severe dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation, confusion, and tachycardia. Assess therapeutic efficacy for movement disorder control and screen for additive anticholinergic burden from other medications (antihistamines, tricyclic antidepressants, antispasmodics).
